title: Enhanced Alchemical Energy Core
text: React one Rough Alchemical Energy Core with 4 B of Dilute Spacetime in a Primitive Reaction Cauldron or Large Alchemical Reaction Pool to produce one Enhanced Alchemical Energy Core. No floor catalyst is required.
A blue-green nucleus floats and rotates among orbiting crystal motes. This placeable component does not process materials on its own.
